card.fires_on: The spot just after a drug name (often a salt like HCL or sulfate) where a dose, strength, ratio or brand name comes next. Seen in tricyclic and epinephrine, atropine, physostigmine passages.

modes.description: The space or opening parenthesis right after a drug name, before a strength or ratio.

modes.label: Salt abbreviation
modes.description: The CL in HCL after a tricyclic drug name, before the brand name.

modes.label: Linking word near drug
modes.description: A small word like are or of right after a drug name or dose term.
